carrara_marble.doc: White marble with soft grey veins, polished (Perlin's marble: bands of a sine bent by turbulence).

nero_marquina.doc: Black marble crossed by a network of fine white calcite veins, polished (veins along the zero crossings of warped noise).

travertine.doc: Cream travertine, honed: wavy bands of deposition, and pits drawn out along them, dark and hollow.

granite.doc: Pink granite, polished: interlocking crystals of feldspar, quartz and biotite, each its own colour.

slate.doc: Riven slate: dark blue-grey, its cleft face stepped where the cleavage planes break off.

concrete.doc: Cast concrete: grey cement mottled by its mix, flecked with sand and aggregate, and air pores left by the form.

terrazzo.doc: Terrazzo, polished: chips of coloured marble set in a white cement, ground flat.

oak.doc: Varnished oak: growth rings, pale earlywood with its large pores and dark latewood, about a trunk along y (after Liu et al., Simulating the structure and texture of solid wood, 2016).

pine.doc: Pine, matt varnished: pale wood with narrow orange-brown latewood bands, rings wide and wavering.

walnut.doc: Oiled walnut: dark chocolate brown with a wavy figure, and small pores throughout.

brushed_steel.doc: Brushed stainless steel: rough across the brushing (along x) and smooth along it, in fine streaks of Gabor noise.

hammered_copper.doc: Hand-hammered copper: overlapping round dimples, each a little smoother than the metal between them.

rusted_iron.doc: Iron rusting through: patches of flaking orange and brown rust raised over dull, pitted steel.

verdigris_copper.doc: Weathered copper: a pale green patina of verdigris over darkened metal, streaked downwards where rain has run.

galvanized_steel.doc: Hot-dip galvanized steel: zinc spangle, crystals centimetres across, each reflecting with its own roughness.

leather.doc: Brown leather: a pebbled grain of creases between rounded cells, and fine pores, with a soft sheen.

cork.doc: Agglomerated cork: granules of bark pressed together, each its own shade, with dark gaps between.

car_paint.doc: Glossy red car paint with the faint orange-peel waviness of a sprayed clear coat.

linen.doc: Undyed linen: a plain weave of slubby threads a millimetre apart, over and under, in the x-z plane.

terracotta.doc: Unglazed terracotta: fired red clay, mottled where it was fired hotter, with a fine gritty surface.

brick_wall.doc: A wall of red bricks in running bond, each brick its own shade, in recessed grey mortar.

dust.doc: Overlay: a fine pale dust settled on whatever faces up, thickest in corners, over the material given as "over".

grime.doc: Overlay: dark dirt gathered in crevices, corners and where objects meet (found by short rays, the occlusion node), in blotches.

rain_streaks.doc: Overlay: dark streaks where rain has run down steep faces, washed from the edges above, longer than they are wide.

moss.doc: Overlay: cushions of moss on what faces up and in damp hollows, patchy, raised and soft-edged.

lichen.doc: Overlay: crustose lichen, round patches with paler rims spreading over stone, more on faces turned up.

mud_splash.doc: Overlay: mud splashed up from the ground, thick at the foot and spattered above, up to "height" metres.

worn_edges.doc: Overlay: paint ("over") worn through on convex edges and corners to what is under it ("under", bare steel by default), in chipped, ragged patches.

grey_granite.doc: Grey granite, polished: white feldspar, glassy grey quartz and black biotite.

weathered_granite.doc: Granite left outdoors: honed dull, its feldspar chalky, stained with iron, grimy in its hollows and patched with lichen.

black_galaxy.doc: Black granite, polished, flecked with coppery bronzite crystals that glint as it turns.

quartzite.doc: Quartzite, honed: a sugary white rock of fused quartz grains, faintly banded grey and rose, glittering slightly.

engineered_quartz.doc: Engineered quartz worktop: crushed quartz in white resin, polished, speckled grey with tiny mirror flecks.

quartz_crystal.doc: Rock crystal: clear quartz (n = 1.544), clouded by milky veils of inclusions; "tint" makes smoky or rose quartz.

rose_quartz.doc: Rose quartz: quartz crystal tinted pink and mostly milky.

calacatta_marble.doc: Calacatta marble: warm white with bold, wide veins of grey and gold, polished.

verde_marble.doc: Verde Alpi: deep green serpentine marble netted with pale green and white veins, polished.

limestone.doc: Honed limestone: pale cream, faintly mottled, with scattered shell fragments and tiny pores.

basalt.doc: Basalt, sawn: fine-grained dark grey volcanic rock with gas bubbles (vesicles) frozen as round holes.

dried_mud.doc: Dried mud: a crust broken into polygons by shrinkage cracks, the plates curling up at their edges.

asphalt.doc: Asphalt road surface: black bitumen packed with grey and pale stones, worn smooth on top.

glazed_tiles.doc: Glazed ceramic tiles, 15 cm square, each fired a shade between "color" and "color2", in pale grout.

plaster.doc: Hand-trowelled lime plaster: off-white, softly mottled, with the shallow sweeps of the trowel.

weathered_oak.doc: Oak left out for years: silvered grey, its soft earlywood worn back so the grain stands up, split by checks along it.

maple.doc: Curly maple, lacquered: pale creamy wood with faint rings and the rippling flame figure of wavy fibres.

ebony.doc: Ebony, French polished: almost black, with faint brown streaks along the grain.

aged_bronze.doc: Cast bronze aged outdoors: dark brown patina, blackest in its hollows, with bright metal rubbed through on the edges.

cast_iron.doc: Cast iron: dark grey and rough from the sand mould, with a little rust in its hollows.

chipped_paint.doc: Painted steel, chipped: "color" paint flaking off in ragged patches and on its edges, showing rust beneath.

granite_outcrop.doc: Weathered granite as it stands in mountains: grey crystalline rock, mottled and iron-stained, black water streaks down its steep faces, grey crusts and yellow-green map lichen on what faces up; relief from centimetres to metres.

limestone_cliff.doc: A limestone crag: pale grey, ochre where freshly broken, striped black by the cyanobacteria that grow where water runs down it, its steep faces fluted by solution (karren) and its tops pitted.

gneiss.doc: Gneiss: metamorphic rock in folded bands of pale quartz and feldspar and dark biotite, the dark bands weathered back.

schist.doc: Mica schist: silvery grey-green rock of fine wavy foliation, glittering where its mica flakes catch the sun.

sandstone.doc: Sandstone as it stands in desert cliffs and ledges: buff to orange, in laminae a few centimetres thick that waver across the face, sugary with grains, stained red with iron in patches and streaked dark with desert varnish down its steep faces; relief of laminae and gently rounded weathering.

scree.doc: Scree: angular stones from fist-sized to grit, packed edge to edge, each its own rock's colour (greys, a purplish and an ochre stone, a few pale ones), its broken faces lighter or darker, dark rims where they meet; modelled on ambientCG's Gravel043.

river_gravel.doc: River gravel: rounded pebbles of many rocks (grey, buff, red-brown, white quartz, black) on sand.

dune_sand.doc: Wind-blown sand: ripples ten centimetres apart across the "wind" direction, gentle upwind and steep downwind, darker heavy minerals in their troughs; smooth on slip faces steeper than the sand rests.

beach_sand.doc: A sandy beach: pale dry sand with shell fragments above, dark glossy wet sand with wave ripples below "waterline" metres (scene y).

mudflat.doc: A tidal mudflat or drying lake bed: dark, wet, glossy mud with water standing in its hollows, cracking where it has dried on the rises.

oak_bark.doc: Old oak bark: thick grey-brown ridges split by deep vertical furrows and broken across, green with algae on the side turned from the sun ("shade", a direction); pale grey-green crusts of lichen in patches over it.

pine_bark.doc: Scots pine bark low on the trunk: thick grey-brown plates, flaking and reddish where fresh, between deep dark fissures.

birch_bark.doc: Silver birch bark: chalky white with dark horizontal lenticels, peeling to orange in places, black and fissured near the ground (below "rough_below" metres, scene y).

beech_bark.doc: Beech bark: smooth thin grey skin, softly mottled, with pale crusts of lichen and the odd ring of wrinkles.

map_lichen.doc: Overlay: map lichen (Rhizocarpon geographicum), the yellow-green crusts of mountain rock, in round colonies bordered black, broken into tiles by black cracks; on surfaces turned to the sky.

wet.doc: Overlay: wet ground or rock, darker and glossy under a film of water: on a landscape where its wetness says (water gathers in hollows), elsewhere "amount" of it in patches.

bedded_sandstone.doc: Thin-bedded sandstone in a cliff: beds a few centimetres to a decimetre thick, each its own shade of ochre and tan, rust-red partings between them, and joints across the beds breaking them into blocks with weathered rims; modelled on Poly Haven's cliff_side.

pebble_bed.doc: A dry river bed of packed rounded pebbles, mostly pale limestone and quartzite with dark basalt among them, a few centimetres across; modelled on Poly Haven's dry_river_pebbles.

angular_rubble.doc: Packed angular grey rubble: broken stones a hand across lying on smaller ones, each its own shade and its faces lighter or darker, dark rims where they meet, soil and dead leaves in the gaps; modelled on Poly Haven's gray_rocks.

lichened_ironstone.doc: Dark iron-stained rock, its grain in streaks, grown with grey-green crustose lichen in fine speckles and drifts; modelled on Poly Haven's lichen_rock.

mossy_slab.doc: A rock slab almost covered by a mosaic of mosses and crustose lichens, yellow-green, olive, grey and black, with dark cracks across it; modelled on Poly Haven's mossy_rock.

ochre_crust.doc: Ochre sandstone weathered to a crust: orange-tan, blotched with dark varnish and cut by sharp dark cracks with rusty walls; modelled on Poly Haven's rock_06.

trail_dirt.doc: A forest trail's compacted brown earth, fine grit and crumbs, with pale stones of mixed sizes scattered sparsely over it; modelled on Poly Haven's forest_ground_04.

laterite.doc: Laterite: the rust-red, iron-rich earth of the tropics, finely grained, with sparse pale and orange nodules; modelled on Poly Haven's red_laterite_soil_stones.

foliated_rock.doc: Foliated metamorphic rock in a quarry face: brown and olive, with dark wavy foliation running across it in broken streaks; modelled on Poly Haven's quarry_wall. The foliation dips along `dip`.

shingle.doc: Grey-beige shingle: small flat stones and grit with sand between, in lighter and darker drifts; modelled on Poly Haven's coast_sand_03.

veined_basalt.doc: Dark basalt in a cliff, near black, crazed by a fine network of pale mineral veins and split by horizontal fractures, with faint brown stains; modelled on Poly Haven's dark_rock.

weathered_grey_rock.doc: Smooth weathered rock, grey-brown, broadly mottled, finely speckled with its grains, and pocked with small dark pits; modelled on Poly Haven's rock_01.

weathered_pink_granite.doc: Coarse pink granite weathered rough: salmon feldspar in blotches among grey-brown quartz and dark mica, the whole dulled and crumbly; modelled on Poly Haven's rock_04.

caliche_ground.doc: Dry gravelly brown soil broken by ragged patches of pale lime crust (caliche) where it shows through; modelled on Poly Haven's coral_gravel.

leaf_litter_gravel.doc: Dark grey gravel strewn with small brown fallen leaves, pointed and ribbed, lying every which way and heaped between the stones; modelled on Poly Haven's leaf_scattered_gravel.

desert_pavement.doc: Desert ground: an ochre crust crazed by fine cracks, darker where it is damp or dusty, with pale angular chips and stones scattered thinly over it and a few darker ones; modelled on Poly Haven's dry_ground_rocks.

dark_stony_soil.doc: Dark stony soil: peaty brown earth thick with grey grit and small angular stones in patches, bare earth between; modelled on Poly Haven's brown_mud_rocks_01.

crazed_sandstone.doc: Weathered sandstone, warm tan and pink, crazed into plates by a network of dark cracks with finer ones between, pitted dark along the cracks; modelled on Poly Haven's rock_boulder_cracked.

mossy_mud.doc: Red-brown mud with patches of small green leaves and sprigs pressed into it, some yellowed, and pale grit; modelled on Poly Haven's brown_mud_leaves_01.

forest_sand.doc: A sandy path in a pine wood: grey-beige sand darkened by humus in patches, with fallen needles, orange-brown and greying, lying in clumps; modelled on Poly Haven's forrest_sand_01.

shore_gravel.doc: Shore gravel at low tide: packed pebbles a centimetre across, brown, grey and olive, each its own shade, strewn with white and lilac fragments of shell; modelled on Poly Haven's low_tide_rocks.

burned_ground.doc: Ground after a fire: charred black soil with grey ash in drifts and brown earth where it burned less, strewn with fallen needles bleached pale and charred twigs; modelled on Poly Haven's burned_ground_01.

mossy_leaf_litter.doc: Woodland floor: olive moss in patches over brown soil, fallen leaves orange-brown and pale, needles and twigs over it all; modelled on Poly Haven's forest_leaves_02.

wet_leaf_mat.doc: Fallen leaves in winter, wet and matted: dark browns lying thickly over one another, a few paler, decaying into the soil; modelled on Poly Haven's winter_leaves.

red_clay_ground.doc: Red clay ground: rusty red-brown earth, paler where dry, crazed by fine cracks, with a few pale stones lying on it; modelled on Poly Haven's red_mud_stones.

root_mat.doc: Bare earth netted with roots: ochre soil and grit with dark roots lying in it, thick ones and fine, thickest in patches; modelled on Poly Haven's roots.

dry_leaf_litter.doc: Dry fallen leaves: orange-brown and tan, curling, lying thick over one another, dark in the gaps between; modelled on Poly Haven's dry_decay_leaves.

petal_strewn_dirt.doc: Brown dirt and grit under a flowering tree, strewn with fallen lilac petals, thicker in drifts, a few browned; modelled on Poly Haven's flower_scattered_dirt.

trodden_snow.doc: Trodden snow: white and slightly blue-grey, scuffed by boots into dirty smears and flecked with grit; modelled on Poly Haven's snow_02.

coastal_turf.doc: Turf on a rocky coast: patches of short green growth over brown earth, broken by pale grey rock showing through; modelled on Poly Haven's coast_sand_rocks_02.

shell_grit.doc: Shell grit: a beach floor of broken shell and small stones a few millimetres across, pale grey, cream and buff, flat and angular; modelled on Poly Haven's shell_floor_01.

sparse_grass.doc: Sparse grass: short green shoots in patches over bare brown soil, with dead straw stems lying across; modelled on Poly Haven's sparse_grass.

patchy_snow.doc: Snow melting off in patches: white lumps over dark olive ground, wet and darker at their edges; modelled on Poly Haven's snow_03.

rocky_trail.doc: A rocky trail: tan dirt packed with grit, pebbles and fist-sized stones, grey, buff and pink, angular; modelled on Poly Haven's rocky_trail.

slabby_path.doc: A forest path of flat grey stone slabs and flakes set in brown earth, with grit between; modelled on Poly Haven's forest_ground_04.

moss_carpet.doc: A carpet of yellow-green moss over rock, thinning to grey bare patches, flecked with pale grit; modelled on Poly Haven's aerial_grass_rock, seen from above.

coral_rubble.doc: Coral rubble: a pale cream crust of cemented sand, broken by hollows full of rounded grains and lumps of broken coral, cream, buff and brown; modelled on Poly Haven's coral_mud_01.

seedling_soil.doc: Dark moist forest soil, crumbly, with tufts of tiny green seedlings and a few pale twigs; modelled on Poly Haven's mud_forest.

cobblestones.doc: Cobbled paving: rough square setts a hand and a half across in wavering rows, blue-grey with some buff ones, rounded and darker at their edges, set in joints of dark grit; modelled on Poly Haven's cobblestone_floor_08.

pitted_ochre_rock.doc: A pitted ochre rock face: pink-orange stone crazed by a network of dark cracks, finer ones between, with grey patina in patches and small pits; modelled on Poly Haven's rock_pitted_mossy.

wood_chip_mulch.doc: Wood-chip mulch: a dense mat of shredded bark and wood chips, slivers of tan, gold and brown over dark gaps; modelled on Poly Haven's wood_chips.

plane_bark.doc: Plane-tree bark: a mosaic of thin flakes, each its own shade of grey-brown, olive and pale grey where older bark has peeled away, with dark edges between; modelled on Poly Haven's bark_platanus.

thatch.doc: Thatch: reeds laid in bundles running down the roof, weathered silver-grey, dark in the gaps between the stems; modelled on Poly Haven's thatch_roof_angled.

autumn_leaf_scatter.doc: Autumn leaves scattered over a bare grey path: red, orange and yellow leaves, some in drifts, on gritty grey-tan earth; modelled on Poly Haven's forest_floor.

dry_stone_wall.doc: A dry-stone wall of flat, rounded rust-brown and grey stones laid in rough courses, dark in the deep joints between them; modelled on Poly Haven's stacked_stone_wall.

clay_roof_tiles.doc: Clay roof tiles: narrow orange-red tiles in long overlapping rows down the roof, each its own shade, many darkened by grime and lichen, with dark gaps between; modelled on Poly Haven's clay_roof_tiles.

concrete_blocks.doc: A wall of concrete blocks, dark grey and speckled with pale aggregate, in stretcher bond with thin joints; modelled on Poly Haven's concrete_block_wall.

grass_path.doc: A worn path: pale grey-beige grit and small stones trodden hard, with scattered tufts of grass; modelled on Poly Haven's grass_path_2.

weathered_boards.doc: Weathered boards: dark brown planks standing side by side, their grain streaked and blotched by the weather, with a few knots and dark gaps between; modelled on Poly Haven's weathered_planks.

stone_block_wall.doc: A wall of rough-dressed grey stone blocks in courses, each its own shade, streaked dark by the weather, with recessed joints; modelled on Poly Haven's rock_wall_08.

hessian.doc: Hessian: coarse jute threads in an open plain weave, tan and uneven, with dark gaps between them; modelled on Poly Haven's hessian_230.

rusty_corrugated_iron.doc: Rusty corrugated iron: sheets corrugated in vertical ridges, rusted through to deep red-brown, streaked orange and pale where rain has run down them; modelled on Poly Haven's rusty_corrugated_iron.

cracked_red_ground.doc: Cracked red ground: dry red-brown earth, mottled darker and paler, with a faint network of shallow cracks; modelled on Poly Haven's cracked_red_ground.

pebble_concrete.doc: Exposed-aggregate concrete: grey cement studded with small rounded pebbles, washed paler in broad streaks; modelled on Poly Haven's pebble_embedded_concrete.

mossy_cobbles.doc: Mossy cobbles: grey and buff setts in rows, rounded at their edges, with bright green moss filling every joint; modelled on Poly Haven's mossy_cobblestone.

snowy_asphalt.doc: Asphalt under thin, broken snow: dark tarmac and grit showing through lacy white patches of snow and grey slush; modelled on Poly Haven's asphalt_snow.

wood_shingles.doc: Wood shingles: narrow split shakes laid in overlapping courses, weathered silver-grey, each its own shade, shadowed under the course above; modelled on Poly Haven's roof_slates_02.

eucalyptus_bark.doc: Smooth eucalyptus bark: brown and rust, shedding in long patches to olive-green and grey beneath, streaked along the trunk; modelled on Poly Haven's eucalyptus_bark.

lunar_regolith.doc: Lunar regolith: fine grey dust, faintly mottled, pocked by small soft craters; modelled on Poly Haven's moon_01.

red_plaster.doc: Weathered red plaster: a terracotta-red render, mottled paler and darker, run with darker stains from above and pocked by small chips; modelled on Poly Haven's red_plaster_weathered.

whitewashed_brick.doc: Whitewashed brick: a wall of bricks in running bond under a worn coat of white, the bricks' red, brown and blue-grey showing through in patches, with pale mortar; modelled on Poly Haven's whitewashed_brick.

mossy_brick.doc: Mossy brick: an old wall of dark red-brown bricks, sooty in places, every joint filled with green moss spilling over the bricks' edges; modelled on Poly Haven's mossy_brick.

green_painted_metal.doc: Green-painted metal: a sheet of flat green paint, mottled and faded, broken by spots of rust with orange halos and a faint run of rust down from them; modelled on Poly Haven's green_metal_rust.

peeling_paint_wood.doc: Peeling paint on wood: dark blue-grey paint flaking off weathered boards in long horizontal tears along the grain, pale grey-brown wood beneath; modelled on Poly Haven's wood_peeling_paint_weathered.

denim.doc: Denim: indigo cotton twill, its fine diagonal ribs flecked with white weft, faded paler in streaks along the warp; modelled on Poly Haven's denim_fabric.

osb.doc: Oriented strand board: long flat flakes of pale wood pressed together at every angle, tan, honey and darker brown; modelled on Poly Haven's oriented_strand_board.

cracked_plaster.doc: Cracked old plaster: a pale grey-green skin crazed into plates by a network of cracks, grime darkening towards every crack; modelled on Poly Haven's worn_cracked_plaster.

cedar_bark.doc: Cedar bark: reddish-brown bark in long fibrous strips running up the trunk, dark furrows between them, greyed by the weather in places; modelled on Poly Haven's chinese_cedar_bark.
